LAURA IMAGE STUDIO v0.9 - MASTER ALL-IN-ONE WORKFLOW

This workflow demonstrates ALL 121 Laura Image Studio nodes.
Organized into functional groups:

1. MODEL LOADING & OPTIMIZATION (Row 1)
2. GENERATION & PROMPT CONTROL (Row 2)
3. FLUX.1 TOOLS - Fill/Depth/Canny/Redux (Row 3)
4. IMG2IMG, INPAINTING & OUTPAINTING (Row 4)
5. BACKGROUND & DRESSING (Row 5)
6. FACE PROCESSING (Row 6)
7. UPSCALING PIPELINE (Row 7)
8. VIDEO ENGINES (Row 8)
9. BATCH & TILE PROCESSING (Row 9)
10. VRAM MANAGEMENT & OUTPUT (Row 10)

GPU REQUIREMENTS:
- 24GB+: Run everything
- 16GB: Use FP8 + sequential groups
- 12GB: FP8 + Extreme offload
- 8GB: FP8 + skip 4K+/video

description:
LAURA IMAGE STUDIO v0.9 - MASTER ALL-IN-ONE WORKFLOW

Comprehensive workflow showcasing ALL 121 Laura Image Studio nodes organized into 16 functional groups:
Model loading with FP8 optimization, LoRA stacking, SDXL + Universal generation,
FLUX.1 Tools (Fill/Depth/Canny/Redux), multi-engine video (CogVideoX/Cosmos/Wan 2.2/HunyuanDiT/HunyuanVideo 2.0),
Wan FunCtrl trajectory control, inpainting/outpainting, background editing,
virtual dressing, face processing, 2K-8K upscaling, cinema video upscale,
batch & tile processing, comparison, toggles, checkpoints, VRAM management.

Supports ALL models: SDXL, Flux, Wan 2.2, SD1.5, SD3, HunyuanDiT, HunyuanVideo 2.0, CogVideoX, Cosmos.
Optimized for 8GB-24GB+ GPUs with FP8 quantization and intelligent VRAM cleanup.
